concepts.learning_objective: Define a multinational corporation (MNC) and distinguish it from a company that only trades abroad.
Explain why and how MNCs divide production into parts and spread it across countries.
Explain investment and foreign investment with examples such as Ford Motors and Cargill Foods.
Describe the ways in which MNCs set up, control or influence production in other countries.

topics.title: Foreign trade and integration of markets
topics.ncert_sections: Foreign trade and integration of markets

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how foreign trade lets producers reach beyond domestic markets and widens buyers' choice.
Explain how foreign trade connects markets, equalises prices and increases competition between countries.
Define globalisation as rapid integration of countries through foreign trade and foreign investment.
Identify the movements of goods, services, investments, technology and people that link countries.

topics.title: Technology as a factor enabling globalisation
topics.ncert_sections: Factors that have enabled globalisation: Technology

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how improvements in transportation technology have stimulated globalisation.
Explain the role of information and communication technology in spreading production of services.

topics.title: Liberalisation, the WTO and steps to attract foreign investment
topics.ncert_sections: Liberalisation of foreign trade and foreign investment policy; World Trade Organisation; Steps to attract foreign investment

concepts.learning_objective: Explain trade barriers such as import taxes and quotas, and the meaning and reasons for liberalisation in India.
Describe the aims of the WTO and evaluate the fairness of its rules for developing countries.
Describe SEZs and flexible labour laws as steps taken to attract foreign investment.

topics.title: Impact of globalisation in India and the struggle for a fair globalisation
topics.ncert_sections: Impact of globalisation in India; The struggle for a fair globalisation

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the groups and companies in India that have benefited from globalisation.
Explain how rising competition has affected small producers and workers.
Explain what fair globalisation means and the role of government and people in achieving it.
